app.name: reimage
app.tagline: Every image tool you need, right in your browser. No uploads, no sign-up, no limits.
app.privacyBadge: 100% client-side — your images never leave your device

workspace.dropTitle: Drop images here, or click to choose
workspace.dropHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, or HEIC where your browser supports it. Nothing is uploaded.
workspace.empty: No images yet. Add some to get started.
workspace.skipped: Skipped {count}: only JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and HEIC are supported.
workspace.targetMissed: Could not reach the target size.
workspace.heicUnsupported: This browser cannot open HEIC photos. Try Safari, or export the photo as JPEG first.

compress.label: Compress
compress.description: Make files smaller. Pick a quality, or set a file size to stay under.
compress.qualityHint: Lower quality means a smaller file.
compress.targetHint: We find the best quality that fits. If needed the image is made slightly smaller.

errors.target: Target size must be at least 1 KB.

convert.label: Convert
convert.description: Change the file format. Pick the format you need and, for lossy formats, the quality.

hints.jpeg: Works everywhere. No transparency: transparent areas turn white.
hints.png: Lossless and keeps transparency. Files are usually larger.
hints.webp: Smaller than JPEG and keeps transparency. Supported by all modern browsers.
hints.avif: Smallest files at the same quality, but slower to encode.

convert.qualityHint: Lower quality means a smaller file.
convert.losslessNote: PNG is lossless, so there is no quality setting.
